nodes.name: Tick every 10s
nodes.notes: How often the screen is read while Clawd is shown. Keep it at 5 s or more: each read is an HTTP request the clock has to answer.

nodes.name: App On Screen (MQTT)
nodes.notes: "+" stands for your MQTT prefix; if the prefix contains a "/", replace "+" with it. The second topic is CONFIG_TOPIC of the view workflow: its MIRROR switches this one on and off.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Same values as the view workflow's Settings. MIRROR here is only the starting value: the view workflow's MIRROR (on CONFIG_TOPIC) takes over as soon as it is published. See docs/REFERENCE.md, "Seeing the pet".

nodes.name: Mirror Gate
nodes.notes: Generated from n8n/clawd-mirror.js. Passes only while MIRROR is on and Clawd is on screen.
